propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper, unlike all other store git paths which route through run_git_write and inherit transient-fault recovery
Three CI test runs fail identically with 'fatal: bad object HEAD' when bundling merged tip, caused by merge commit object briefly unreadable from object database
The transient read failure is proven to occur at bundle time (object absent not corrupt) but the runner-side trigger mechanism remains unproven and unreproduced locally
Existing gitutil transient-marker family already handles similar object-DB read blips in other store paths; s3_doctor must reuse that seam instead of remaining outside the self-healing boundary
S3DoctorConflict error message misdescribes object-DB read failures as heads conflicts and directs operator to wrong recovery tool
